Seat ruling 2026-11-27T21:06Z on how the `osv-scanner.toml` exemption is removed before 2026-12-21: **option A**.

- **Where things stand.** Draft PR #38049 (`Part of #36160`, head `8a12fac9`, report 7228114414) moves five upstreams to minimatch 11. It also splits the exceljs chain's override by major version. The one 10.x copy left is `@microsoft/api-extractor`, whose latest version, 7.60.2, still pins `minimatch` 10.2.3 exactly.
- **Ruling.** A follow-up PR adds the scoped override `@microsoft/api-extractor>minimatch → ^11.0.9` and removes the exemption (`Fixes #36160`). It is reversible, and it needs no maintainer ruling. api-extractor is only an optional peer that tsup and vite-plugin-dts install. No build in this repository turns it on, and its one `minimatch()` call is API-compatible in v11. Option B (keep api-extractor out of the install) costs a measurement the deadline does not need. Option C (renew the exemption) only postpones the removal.
- **The follow-up PR must show three things:**
  - a reading that no tsup or vite-plugin-dts config turns api-extractor on;
  - a clean local OSV scan with the exemption removed;
  - zero minimatch 10.x copies in the lockfile.
  A comment beside the override states the reason, and that the override is removed once api-extractor drops its exact pin.
